setup_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openjdk-17-jdk-headless git curl unzip python3 ca-certificates && mkdir -p /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && curl -fsSL https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-13114758_latest.zip -o /tmp/android-tools.zip && unzip -q /tmp/android-tools.zip -d /tmp/android-tools && mv /tmp/android-tools/cmdline-tools /opt/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest && rm -rf /tmp/android-tools /tmp/android-tools.zip && ln -s "$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v java)")")")" /opt/java17
